content.trans: 英语：你知不知道，我以前住在瑞士。

content.text: and in Switzerland, you would have to eat before you watch the movie.
content.trans: 和在瑞士观看电影之前，你必须先吃晚饭。

content.text: There was no popcorn, no soda, no candy inside the movie theater.
content.trans: 电影放映厅里没有点心、饮料或糖果。

content.text: Can you imagine that?
content.trans: 能想象到吗？

content.text: I could not live with that,
content.trans: 我不能忍受那个。

content.text: because the whole purpose of going to the movies
content.trans: 因为去电影院的全部目的。

content.text: is to have some popcorn and relax and have a good time.
content.trans: 英语：点和拍 = 傻瓜相机

content.text: You can't have a movie without popcorn.
content.trans: 你不能没有电影，没有 popcorn。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: Okay, so we've talked a lot about how to ask someone to be quiet today.
content.trans: 好的，今天我们讨论了如何让某人安静。

content.text: And I hope that you'll go out and try a few of these phrases in your daily life.
content.trans: 并且我希望你每天尝试一下这些短语。

content.text: Yes, and I hope also that you visit our website at www.englishpod.com
content.trans: 是的，我也希望你也能够访问我们的网站：www.englishpod.com。

content.text: and leave all your questions and comments.
content.trans: 和放下所有问题和评论。

content.text: Marco and I are there every day, so we'll be happy to answer your questions.
content.trans: 英语：Marco 和我每天都在这里，所以我们将很高兴回答你的问题。

content.text: But until next time, bye!
content.trans: 但是直到下次，再见！

content.text: Bye!
